description: This file declares the TrustStoreMac class, an implementation of TrustStore that uses macOS keychain to find trust anchors for certificate path building. It includes enums for trust debug info, trust implementation types, and a nested class for debug data. The class provides methods for trust evaluation, issuer retrieval, and trust cache initialization, with static helper functions for certificate matching and normalization.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac
classes.description: Implementation of TrustStore using macOS keychain for trust anchors, with thread safety and trust cache management.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac::ResultDebugData
classes.description: Class for storing debug data related to trust evaluation, including trust debug info flags and trust implementation type.

methods.description: Initializes the trust cache if not already initialized.
